chat.kpitemsrarity.share_hint: Hover an item (or hold it) to share it
chat.kpitemsrarity.share_cooldown: Wait a moment before sharing again

lore.minecraft.wooden_sword: Whittled on a winter night. Every hero started with a blade like this one.
lore.minecraft.wooden_axe: The first tool of village builders. It still smells of sap.
lore.minecraft.wooden_pickaxe: It breaks more often than it digs, but it's a start.
lore.minecraft.wooden_shovel: Sturdy enough for loose dirt, not for trouble.
lore.minecraft.wooden_hoe: The kingdom's first fields were drawn with this stick.
lore.minecraft.stone_sword: Heavy, blunt, honest. Hamlet guards swear by it.
lore.minecraft.stone_axe: A stone, a handle, and enough anger to fell an oak.
lore.minecraft.stone_pickaxe: The tool of surface miners, those who don't dare go deeper yet.
lore.minecraft.stone_shovel: It has dug more graves than gardens.
lore.minecraft.stone_hoe: Valley farmers say it brings luck to the harvest.
lore.minecraft.iron_sword: The Iron Guard's standard blade. Reliable and plain, like those who carry it.
lore.minecraft.iron_axe: Northern woodcutters keep it close, in case the wolves come back.
lore.minecraft.iron_pickaxe: Forged for the depths. Iron sings when it hits diamond.
lore.minecraft.iron_shovel: It opened the first roads between villages.
lore.minecraft.iron_hoe: They say a field ploughed with iron grows golden wheat.
lore.minecraft.iron_helmet: Dented by a thousand patrols, it always held.
lore.minecraft.iron_chestplate: The heart of the Iron Guard. The names of the fallen are engraved inside.
lore.minecraft.iron_leggings: Heavy to wear, heavier to leave behind.
lore.minecraft.iron_boots: They have walked every road of the kingdom.
lore.minecraft.golden_sword: Made to shine at court rather than bleed in battle. Gold panners love it.
lore.minecraft.golden_axe: A noble's whim. It dulls quickly but draws luck.
lore.minecraft.golden_pickaxe: Gold panners swear it finds the veins on its own.
lore.minecraft.golden_shovel: Digging with gold: an idea only the rich could have.
lore.minecraft.golden_hoe: Given to the most deserving farmers at the harvest festival.
lore.minecraft.golden_helmet: A gold seeker's crown. It draws looks, and trouble.
lore.minecraft.golden_chestplate: More prestige than protection. Piglins never get tired of it.
lore.minecraft.golden_leggings: They jingle at every step, like a full purse.
lore.minecraft.golden_boots: Piglins will let you pass. Thieves, much less so.
lore.minecraft.chainmail_helmet: A tight mail hood, the gear of scouts who travel light.
lore.minecraft.chainmail_chestplate: Thousands of rings, thousands of nights on the road.
lore.minecraft.chainmail_leggings: Supple enough to run, strong enough to survive the run.
lore.minecraft.chainmail_boots: Scouts know them by their sound: a whisper of metal in the grass.
lore.minecraft.leather_helmet: The prowler's cap. It smells of rain, smoke and forest.
lore.minecraft.leather_chestplate: Old-fashioned tanned leather, sewn by a patient hand.
lore.minecraft.leather_leggings: Made to walk for days without a sound.
lore.minecraft.leather_boots: A prowler leaves no tracks. Neither do his boots.
lore.minecraft.diamond_sword: The champions' blade. Those who carry it need no introduction.
lore.minecraft.diamond_axe: It splits wood, stone and certainties.
lore.minecraft.diamond_pickaxe: Every miner's dream. It pierced the heart of the mountain.
lore.minecraft.diamond_shovel: An absurd luxury only the greatest builders understand.
lore.minecraft.diamond_hoe: Legend says a farmer forged it to humiliate a king.
lore.minecraft.diamond_helmet: The helmet of arena champions. Its shine blinds opponents.
lore.minecraft.diamond_chestplate: You don't win this chestplate. You earn it.
lore.minecraft.diamond_leggings: Cut for those who never step back.
lore.minecraft.diamond_boots: They have trodden the sand of every arena in the kingdom.
lore.minecraft.netherite_sword: Quenched in the lava of the Nether Lords. It remembers the flames.
lore.minecraft.netherite_axe: A conqueror's weapon. The whole Nether shook as it passed.
lore.minecraft.netherite_pickaxe: It dug to the bones of the world, where ancient debris sleeps.
lore.minecraft.netherite_shovel: Even Nether ash steps aside for it.
lore.minecraft.netherite_hoe: A lord's scythe. Better not ask what it has reaped.
lore.minecraft.netherite_helmet: The Nether Lords' helm. Fire itself breaks upon it.
lore.minecraft.netherite_leggings: Heavy as an oath, solid as a fortress.
lore.minecraft.netherite_boots: They walk on lava like on a carpet.
lore.minecraft.bow: A prowler's bow, supple and silent. The forest saw it born.
lore.minecraft.crossbow: The scouts' weapon: precise, patient, merciless.
lore.minecraft.shield: The Iron Guard's shield. It has taken more blows than any guard.
lore.minecraft.trident: Torn from the drowned of the abyss. The sea still wants it back.
lore.minecraft.mace: A weapon from the Trial Chambers. The higher the fall, the harder it hits.
lore.minecraft.turtle_helmet: A shell blessed by the sea. You breathe easier under the waves.
lore.set.kpitemsrarity.leather: Those who live in the woods need no walls. They have the bow, the wind and patience.
lore.set.kpitemsrarity.chainmail: Always a day ahead of the army. Scouts see the enemy before it sees them.
lore.set.kpitemsrarity.golden: The river gives gold back to those who can wait. And sometimes, a little more.
lore.set.kpitemsrarity.iron: They don't retreat. They don't bend. As long as an iron guard stands, the village sleeps.
lore.set.kpitemsrarity.diamond: The arena sand remembers every champion. Few made it out alive.
lore.set.kpitemsrarity.netherite: Those who conquered the Nether no longer fear the flames. The flames fear them.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.spawn_egg: A rather special egg. Set it down and {mob} hatches out.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.music_disc: Slip it into a jukebox and let {song} play.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.tipped_arrow: Coated arrow that gives {effects} to the target.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.lingering_potion: When thrown, leaves a lingering cloud that gives {effects}.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.splash_potion: When thrown, gives {effects} to everything around the impact.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.food: Good for the road.|It fills a gap between two adventures.|Travelers always keep some at the bottom of the bag.|Better to have some when hunger strikes.|Simple, but it sets you right.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.food_effects: Edible, but it leaves a mark. You come out of it with {effects}.|Filling, with a little extra on the side: {effects}.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.horse_armor: Protection made for a horse, sewn or forged to measure.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.wolf_armor: Protection for your tamed wolf, made of armadillo scutes.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.armor: Solid protection for dangerous roads.|Better to wear it than to regret it.|It has already taken a few hits.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.sword: A reliable blade for bad encounters.|Sharp, balanced, ready to serve.|It has already seen a few fights.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.pickaxe: To dig stone and look for ore.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.axe: It chops wood, and sometimes the rest.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.ranged: To strike from afar, before you get struck.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.mob_bucket: Bucket holding a creature, release it in water.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.enchanted_book: A book heavy with magic. Put it on an anvil with an item to pass its enchantments on.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.smithing_templat: Smithing template, used at a smithing table.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.banner_pattern: Pattern to apply to a banner with a loom.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.dye: Dye to color wool, leather, glass and banners.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.ingot: A metal ingot, the basis of every forge.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.nugget: A small nugget. Nine make an ingot.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.gem: A precious gem, sought after by crafters and merchants.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.dust: A fine powder, useful in crafting.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.raw_material: Raw ore, smelt it in a furnace.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.fuel: Enough to feed a furnace for {fuel} s.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.tool: A tool that wears out from use.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.material: A material crafters know how to use.|Merchants always buy some.|It will come in handy someday.|A resource that belongs in a workshop.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.ore: Ore still caught in the rock. The mine always hides a little more further in.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.log: Raw wood, still covered in bark.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.planks: Planks, ready for the crafting table.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.leaves: Foliage. Sometimes it hides a sapling or an apple.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.sapling: A tree sapling. Plant it and be patient.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.flower: A wild flower. Dyers love it.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.wool: Wool, it can be dyed and is used for beds and banners.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.bed: A good bed skips the night in one go, and it's where you'll wake up if things go wrong.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.glass: Transparent glass, it lets light through.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.storage_block: Compact block of resources, reversible at a crafting table.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.door: Opens and closes with a click.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.candle: Candle to light, up to four per block.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.storage: Somewhere to keep your treasures safe.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.utility_block: A useful block, place it and use it with a right click.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.block: A block to build with.|Enough to build a whole village.|Builders always need some.
desc.minecraft.totem_of_undying: Prevents its holder's death and gives {effects}. Breaks when used.
desc.minecraft.ender_pearl: When thrown, teleports you where it lands, at the cost of some health.
desc.minecraft.ender_eye: When thrown, leads to the nearest stronghold. Opens the End portal.
desc.minecraft.elytra: Wings taken from the end of the world. Jump into the void to glide, and a firework pushes you on when you slow down.
desc.minecraft.firework_rocket: Firework. While gliding with elytra, it propels you forward.
desc.minecraft.flint_and_steel: Lights a fire or a Nether portal.
desc.minecraft.fire_charge: Lights a fire from a distance when shot from a dispenser.
desc.minecraft.compass: Points to the world spawn, or to a linked lodestone.
desc.minecraft.recovery_compass: Points to where you last died.
desc.minecraft.clock: Shows the time of day, even underground.
desc.minecraft.map: A blank map, only waiting for your steps to fill it in.
desc.minecraft.filled_map: Map of the area. Expand it at a cartography table.
desc.minecraft.spyglass: Hold right click and the distance comes close. Handy for seeing trouble coming.
desc.minecraft.lead: Lead to tie up and guide animals.
desc.minecraft.name_tag: Names a creature. A named creature never despawns.
desc.minecraft.saddle: Saddle to ride horses, pigs and striders.
desc.minecraft.golden_apple: An apple coated in gold, far too pricey for a snack. Restores {nutrition} hunger points and grants {effects}.
desc.minecraft.enchanted_golden_apple: The most precious of apples, the one you save for the worst moment. Grants {effects}.
desc.minecraft.chorus_fruit: Edible, teleports you randomly a few blocks away.
desc.minecraft.honey_bottle: Restores {nutrition} hunger points and cures poison.
desc.minecraft.milk_bucket: Removes every effect, good and bad.
desc.minecraft.bone_meal: Instantly grows plants, crops and trees.
desc.minecraft.wind_charge: When thrown, a gust pushes away everything it hits, you included.
desc.minecraft.egg: When thrown, a chick sometimes comes out.
desc.minecraft.goat_horn: Horn to blow, heard from very far away.
desc.minecraft.brush: An archaeologist's brush, for patiently dusting off suspicious sand and gravel. Treasures don't like to be rushed.
desc.minecraft.shears: Shears sheep and cuts leaves, cobwebs and grass.
desc.minecraft.bucket: A plain bucket. Water, lava, powder snow or milk: it isn't picky.
desc.minecraft.bundle: Bag that groups several small items in one slot.
desc.minecraft.writable_book: Book to write in, then sign.
desc.minecraft.book: A book with pages still blank. It feeds enchanting tables and fills bookshelves.
desc.minecraft.nether_star: Torn from the Wither. The heart of a beacon.
desc.minecraft.heart_of_the_sea: Treasure of the oceans, the heart of a conduit.
desc.minecraft.dragon_breath: The dragon's breath, trapped in a bottle. It turns splash potions into clouds that linger.
desc.minecraft.glass_bottle: Empty bottle, fill it with water or honey.
desc.minecraft.item_frame: Frame to display an item on a wall.
desc.minecraft.glow_item_frame: Glowing frame to display an item, visible in the dark.
desc.minecraft.painting: Painting to hang on a wall.
desc.minecraft.end_crystal: End crystal. Explodes violently when hit.
desc.minecraft.respawn_anchor: Nether respawn anchor, charged with glowstone.
desc.minecraft.lodestone: A stubbornly magnetic stone. A compass bound to it will always point its way, wherever you are.
desc.minecraft.ender_chest: A chest that opens onto somewhere else. What you store in it waits for you in every ender chest.
desc.minecraft.shulker_box: A box made from a shulker's shell. Break it, carry it off: nothing falls out.
desc.minecraft.crafting_table: A sturdy crafting table and its 3 x 3 grid. Almost everything starts here.
desc.minecraft.furnace: A stone furnace that cooks meat and smelts ore, never complaining about the heat.
desc.minecraft.blast_furnace: A blast furnace that smelts ore twice as fast. It has no patience for food.
desc.minecraft.smoker: A smoker that cooks food twice as fast. Ore, it leaves to others.
desc.minecraft.anvil: A heavy, loyal anvil. You repair, rename and combine enchantments on it, until it finally gives way.
desc.minecraft.enchanting_table: A table where knowledge is paid for in experience and lapis lazuli. The more books around it, the more generous it gets.
desc.minecraft.brewing_stand: A brewing stand to make potions. A little chemistry, a lot of trial and error.
desc.minecraft.smithing_table: The smith's table. With the right template, it gives your gear a second life.
desc.minecraft.grindstone: A grindstone that repairs items and strips their enchantments. It gives back a little experience for the trouble.
desc.minecraft.stonecutter: A blade that spins without end and cuts stone precisely, wasting nothing.
desc.minecraft.loom: A loom to adorn banners with patterns. Every village has its colors.
desc.minecraft.cartography_table: The cartographer's table. It copies maps, expands them and locks them.
desc.minecraft.composter: A composter where plants end up as bone meal. Nothing goes to waste in the garden.
desc.minecraft.jukebox: A jukebox, so music can fill the house.
desc.minecraft.note_block: Plays a note, the sound depends on the block below.
desc.minecraft.beacon: A beacon made from a star. Set on a pyramid of precious blocks, it grants its powers to everyone nearby.
desc.minecraft.conduit: A conduit that calms the ocean around it. Underwater, you see clearly and breathe freely.
desc.minecraft.cake: Cake to place and share, slice by slice.
desc.minecraft.blaze_powder: Blaze powder, still warm. It's what keeps the brewing stand burning.
desc.minecraft.blaze_rod: A blaze rod that burns {fuel} s in a furnace. Ground down, it becomes the alchemists' powder.
desc.minecraft.coal: A lump of coal that burns {fuel} s in a furnace. The first treasure of every mine.
desc.minecraft.charcoal: Charcoal that burns {fuel} s in a furnace. When the mine is too far, the forest helps out.
desc.minecraft.lava_bucket: Bucket of lava. Burns {fuel} s in a furnace.
desc.minecraft.water_bucket: Bucket of water, pour it anywhere.
desc.minecraft.magma_cream: Magma cream, ingredient of fire resistance potions.
desc.minecraft.ghast_tear: Ghast tear, ingredient of regeneration potions.
desc.minecraft.phantom_membrane: A phantom membrane, supple and cold. It's what you need to mend elytra.
desc.minecraft.rabbit_foot: Rabbit's foot, ingredient of leaping potions.
desc.minecraft.glistering_melon_slice: Glistering melon slice, ingredient of healing potions.
desc.minecraft.golden_carrot: A golden carrot, is it really edible?
desc.minecraft.fermented_spider_eye: A fermented spider eye, which turns a potion's effect around. What healed starts to hurt.
desc.minecraft.nether_wart: Nether wart, the base of almost every potion.
desc.minecraft.redstone: A red dust that carries a signal. With enough patience, it runs whole machines.
desc.minecraft.lapis_lazuli: A deep blue stone. Without it, no enchanting table answers.
desc.minecraft.emerald: An emerald, the only currency villagers truly respect.
desc.minecraft.diamond: A diamond, enough to forge the best tools and armor. Or to show off a little.
desc.minecraft.netherite_ingot: A netherite ingot, used to upgrade your diamond gear. Or just to show off.
desc.minecraft.turtle_scute: A scute left behind by a young turtle as it grew. Enough of them make a shell.
desc.minecraft.armadillo_scute: An armadillo scute, hard as horn. Your wolf will thank you for the armor it makes.
desc.minecraft.trial_key: A key earned in the sweat of the trials. It opens a trial chamber vault.
desc.minecraft.ominous_trial_key: An ominous key, earned in the hardest trials. It opens an ominous vault.
desc.minecraft.ominous_bottle: An ominous bottle. Drink it, and the next trial will be much harder, and much more rewarding.
desc.minecraft.heavy_core: A core of impossible weight. With a breeze rod, it becomes a mace.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.fish: Caught in the waters of the kingdom.|Harbor merchants pay a good price for it.|It is still flapping a little.|A fine fish, to grill or to sell.|Fishers tell each other about its size for days.|It smells of the river and early morning.
lore.minecraft.totem_of_undying: Evokers carry it to cheat death. Only once.
lore.minecraft.elytra: Torn from the End ships. The sky has no more limits.
lore.minecraft.nether_star: The Wither's heart, still shining with its rage.
lore.minecraft.heart_of_the_sea: Old sailors say it still beats on stormy nights.
lore.minecraft.enchanted_golden_apple: An apple you eat once in a lifetime.
lore.minecraft.dragon_egg: The dragon's last memory. Some say it will hatch one day.
lore.minecraft.ender_pearl: It has seen the End. It wants to take you there, bit by bit.
lore.minecraft.trial_key: It wears out at the first turn of the lock, as if the trial devoured it.
desc.kpitemsrarity.auto.edible_weapon: A delicious weapon.|As sharp as it is tasty.|Something to fight with... and something to eat afterwards.|Fearsome in battle, excellent grilled.
lore.minecraft.apple: One a day keeps the zombies away, travelers say.
lore.minecraft.baked_potato: Baked under campfire embers, it warms the hands as much as the belly.
lore.minecraft.potato: The farmers' humble treasure. Without it, winters would be much longer.
lore.minecraft.poisonous_potato: Green and bitter. The farmer who planted it will never admit it.
lore.minecraft.carrot: Pigs would follow it to the end of the world.
lore.minecraft.beetroot: It stains fingers and aprons. Village cooks love it.
lore.minecraft.beetroot_soup: A bright red soup, served steaming in inns on stormy nights.
lore.minecraft.bread: The baker's bread, still warm. It smells of wheat and morning.
lore.minecraft.cookie: A grandmother's recipe, with cocoa from faraway jungles.
lore.minecraft.pumpkin_pie: There is always a slice kept for the neighbors.
lore.minecraft.melon_slice: Juicy and fresh, it makes you forget the desert heat.
lore.minecraft.glow_berries: Some say they light up dreams.
lore.minecraft.sweet_berries: They prick. Foxes wait for someone to pick them.
lore.minecraft.dried_kelp: Salty and crunchy, the long-haul sailors' favorite ration.
lore.minecraft.kelp: Forests under the sea that grow up to the surface. Fish hide in them.
lore.minecraft.beef: Raw cow meat. Cook it, unless you are in a real hurry.
lore.minecraft.cooked_beef: A well-done steak. Nothing sets you right better after a fight.
lore.minecraft.porkchop: A raw pork chop. The pig did not give it willingly.
lore.minecraft.cooked_porkchop: You can smell it across the village.
lore.minecraft.chicken: Raw chicken. Do not eat it like this.
lore.minecraft.cooked_chicken: A roast chicken, golden and crispy. The meal of feast days.
lore.minecraft.mutton: Raw mutton, the meat of hill shepherds.
lore.minecraft.cooked_mutton: Herb-roasted mutton, the way shepherds make it at night.
lore.minecraft.rabbit: A meadow rabbit. It ran fast, but not fast enough.
lore.minecraft.cooked_rabbit: A roasted rabbit, the reward of patient hunters.
lore.minecraft.rabbit_stew: The hunters' stew: rabbit, carrot, potato and mushroom. Nothing goes to waste.
lore.minecraft.mushroom_stew: A bowl of simmered mushrooms, the mushroom islands' specialty.
lore.minecraft.suspicious_stew: Nobody really knows what is inside. That is exactly what makes it interesting.
lore.minecraft.cod: Harbor market cod, caught before dawn.
lore.minecraft.cooked_cod: A grilled cod, simple and perfect.
lore.minecraft.salmon: It swims upstream, never giving up.
lore.minecraft.cooked_salmon: A grilled salmon, pink and tender. The fishers' favorite dish.
lore.minecraft.tropical_fish: Colors no painter would dare. Too pretty to eat. Almost.
lore.minecraft.pufferfish: It puffs up when scared. So will you, if you eat it.
lore.minecraft.rotten_flesh: Torn from a zombie. Only wolves and very hungry people touch it.
lore.minecraft.spider_eye: A spider eye, still moist. Alchemists know what to do with it.
lore.minecraft.popped_chorus_fruit: A chorus fruit popped in a furnace. It no longer teleports, but it shines.
lore.minecraft.sugar: Cane sugar, the sweetness of kitchens and the secret of speed potions.
lore.minecraft.honeycomb: A wax comb taken from bees. They will remember.
lore.minecraft.wheat: A sheaf of golden wheat. The whole village lives off these fields.
lore.minecraft.wheat_seeds: Wheat seeds, the promise of future bread.
lore.minecraft.beetroot_seeds: Beetroot seeds, for the most colorful fields.
lore.minecraft.melon_seeds: Melon seeds. Plant them and summer will come on its own.
lore.minecraft.pumpkin_seeds: Pumpkin seeds, for autumn harvests and jack o'lanterns.
lore.minecraft.torchflower_seeds: Ancient seeds dug up by a sniffer. They waited for centuries.
lore.minecraft.pitcher_pod: An ancient pod a sniffer found. Nobody has seen its flower in ages.
lore.minecraft.pitcher_plant: A forgotten plant of the ancient world, back thanks to sniffers.
lore.minecraft.cocoa_beans: Jungle cocoa beans. They always end up as cookies.
lore.minecraft.sugar_cane: It grows by the water. Library paper starts here.
lore.minecraft.bamboo: It grows so fast you can almost hear it. Pandas think of nothing else.
lore.minecraft.mangrove_propagule: A mangrove propagule, ready to take root in the mud.
lore.minecraft.pink_petals: Cherry petals. They fall like pink snow in spring.
lore.minecraft.nether_sprouts: Small Nether sprouts that grow where nothing should.
lore.minecraft.seagrass: The underwater meadows where turtles sleep.
lore.minecraft.sea_pickle: A small glowing reef creature. It lights up nights under the sea.
lore.minecraft.bone: A skeleton bone. Dogs want it, farmers grind it.
lore.minecraft.string: Bows and fishing rods owe it everything.
lore.minecraft.gunpowder: Creeper powder. Keep it away from fire, and away from creepers.
lore.minecraft.feather: A chicken feather. Archers glue it to the end of their arrows.
lore.minecraft.leather: Bags, books and armor. It all starts with a cow.
lore.minecraft.rabbit_hide: Soft and light. Four make one leather.
lore.minecraft.ink_sac: A frightened squid's ink. Scribes use it to write.
lore.minecraft.glow_ink_sac: Write with it, and your sign can be read at night.
lore.minecraft.shulker_shell: The shell of an End city shulker. It closes on its own.
lore.minecraft.nautilus_shell: A spiral shell, given by the drowned to those who beat them.
lore.minecraft.breeze_rod: A breeze's rod from the trial chambers. The wind still spins inside.
lore.minecraft.turtle_egg: Turtle eggs, laid on the beach where it was born. Protect them from zombies.
lore.minecraft.sniffer_egg: A sniffer egg, from a vanished creature. Hatch it on moss.
lore.minecraft.echo_shard: A shard from the ancient city. It whispers the sounds it has heard.
lore.minecraft.disc_fragment_5: A disc piece found in the ancient city. Eight more are missing.
lore.minecraft.broken_elytra: Elytra worn to the thread. A phantom membrane will mend them.
lore.minecraft.raw_iron: Raw iron, still full of rock. The furnace will do the rest.
lore.minecraft.raw_gold: Raw gold, heavy and dull. It will shine after the furnace.
lore.minecraft.iron_ingot: Tools, armor, rails, buckets. Iron is everywhere.
lore.minecraft.gold_ingot: A gold ingot. Piglins stop fighting just to look at it.
lore.minecraft.copper_ingot: It turns green with time, like old roofs.
lore.minecraft.iron_nugget: An iron nugget. Nine make an ingot, one makes a lantern.
lore.minecraft.gold_nugget: A gold nugget, found in a stream or on a zombified piglin.
lore.minecraft.netherite_scrap: A piece of ancient debris. It does not burn, even in lava.
lore.minecraft.quartz: White as snow, in the middle of flames.
lore.minecraft.amethyst_shard: An amethyst shard. It chimes like a bell when touched.
lore.minecraft.prismarine_shard: A shard of the monument under the sea. It keeps the color of the deep.
lore.minecraft.prismarine_crystals: Crystals that shine like the sea in the sun. Sea lanterns are made of them.
lore.minecraft.glowstone_dust: A dust of light. Alchemists put it in everything.
lore.minecraft.flint: Struck against iron, it gives birth to fire.
lore.minecraft.clay_ball: A ball of wet clay, gathered from a riverbed.
lore.minecraft.brick: The finest houses are made of them.
lore.minecraft.nether_brick: A Nether brick, dark and hard like the fortresses.
lore.minecraft.stick: A simple stick. It holds every tool in the kingdom.
lore.minecraft.bowl: A wooden bowl. It is waiting for soup.
lore.minecraft.paper: Maps, books and fireworks start here.
lore.minecraft.pointed_dripstone: A stalactite fallen from the ceiling. Never walk under one.
lore.minecraft.firework_star: A firework star. It sets the color and shape of the explosion.
lore.minecraft.arrow: A straight, well-fletched arrow. Archers always have one too many.
lore.minecraft.fishing_rod: A rod of wood and string. Patience does the rest.
lore.minecraft.enchanted_book: A tome whose pages turn on their own.
lore.minecraft.written_book: A written and signed book. Someone put their ideas, or their secrets, in it.
lore.minecraft.knowledge_book: A book that teaches recipes at a single glance.
lore.minecraft.bell: The village bell. When it rings, everyone goes inside.
lore.minecraft.lantern: An iron lantern, the light of long night roads.
lore.minecraft.soul_lantern: A lantern with blue flames. Piglins keep away from it.
lore.minecraft.campfire: A campfire. You cook on it, warm up by it, tell stories around it.
lore.minecraft.soul_campfire: A blue campfire, colder than fire and more unsettling.
lore.minecraft.candle: A wax candle. Light it for a vigil or a prayer.
lore.minecraft.chain: An iron chain, to hang lanterns or hold what must be held.
lore.minecraft.flower_pot: A flower pot, to put a little life on the windowsill.
lore.minecraft.cauldron: An iron cauldron. It holds water, lava or powder snow.
lore.minecraft.repeater: It delays the signal, just long enough.
lore.minecraft.comparator: It compares, it measures, it judges.
lore.minecraft.minecart: An iron minecart, to travel on mine rails.
lore.minecraft.chest_minecart: A minecart with a chest, to bring the mine loot home.
lore.minecraft.furnace_minecart: A minecart that runs on coal by itself.
lore.minecraft.hopper_minecart: A minecart that picks up everything in its way.
lore.minecraft.tnt_minecart: Hasty miners love it. Everyone else fears it.
lore.minecraft.command_block_minecart: It obeys orders written by the world's gods.
lore.minecraft.leather_horse_armor: A leather horse armor, dyed in its rider's colors.
lore.minecraft.iron_horse_armor: An iron armor for patrol horses.
lore.minecraft.golden_horse_armor: Prettier than sturdy. Parade horses wear it proudly.
lore.minecraft.diamond_horse_armor: The champions' horse armor. Rarely sold, always envied.
lore.minecraft.wolf_armor: It protects you. You protect it.
lore.minecraft.cod_bucket: A cod in a bucket, waiting for the market or the aquarium.
lore.minecraft.salmon_bucket: A salmon in a bucket. It is already looking for the river.
lore.minecraft.pufferfish_bucket: A pufferfish in a bucket. Do not shake it.
lore.minecraft.tropical_fish_bucket: A tropical fish in a bucket, for the home aquarium.
lore.minecraft.tadpole_bucket: A tadpole in a bucket. It will become a frog, if you wait.
lore.minecraft.powder_snow_bucket: Goats walk on it. Everyone else sinks.
lore.minecraft.structure_void: A void that is not one.
lore.minecraft.light: Pure light, with no source and no flame.
lore.minecraft.white_dye: White as the wool of hill sheep.
lore.minecraft.light_gray_dye: The light gray of misty mornings.
lore.minecraft.brown_dye: The brown of cocoa and tilled earth.
lore.minecraft.red_dye: Red as poppies. And as war banners.
lore.minecraft.orange_dye: The orange of tulips and sunsets.
lore.minecraft.lime_dye: Lime green, the most cheerful color at the market.
lore.minecraft.green_dye: The green of desert cacti, baked in a furnace.
lore.minecraft.light_blue_dye: Light blue as a summer sky.
lore.minecraft.blue_dye: Lapis lazuli blue, the color of mages.
lore.minecraft.purple_dye: The color of kings and enchanters.
lore.minecraft.magenta_dye: For those who want to be noticed.
lore.minecraft.angler_pottery_sherd: An ancient sherd: a fisher and their catch, carved centuries ago.
lore.minecraft.archer_pottery_sherd: An archer drawing a bow. The ancients already hunted like us.
lore.minecraft.arms_up_pottery_sherd: Someone raises their arms to the sky. Joy, or prayer?
lore.minecraft.blade_pottery_sherd: A sword carved in clay. Wars are older than kings.
lore.minecraft.brewer_pottery_sherd: A flask and its fumes. Alchemy is nothing new.
lore.minecraft.danger_pottery_sherd: A creeper, drawn by an ancient. They were already here.
lore.minecraft.explorer_pottery_sherd: A carved map, for those who went far away.
lore.minecraft.flow_pottery_sherd: A wind spiral, found in the trial chambers.
lore.minecraft.friend_pottery_sherd: A face that has been smiling for a thousand years.
lore.minecraft.guster_pottery_sherd: A breeze's gust, frozen in clay.
lore.minecraft.heart_pottery_sherd: A carved heart. A lover's gift, perhaps.
lore.minecraft.heartbreak_pottery_sherd: Some stories end badly, even carved ones.
lore.minecraft.howl_pottery_sherd: A wolf howling at the moon.
lore.minecraft.miner_pottery_sherd: A carved pickaxe. Someone was already digging beneath our feet.
lore.minecraft.mourner_pottery_sherd: A mourning figure, carved near a forgotten city.
lore.minecraft.plenty_pottery_sherd: A full chest. The symbol of plentiful harvests.
lore.minecraft.prize_pottery_sherd: A carved gem, an ancient merchant's treasure.
lore.minecraft.scrape_pottery_sherd: A carved axe, worn by time.
lore.minecraft.sheaf_pottery_sherd: A sheaf of wheat. Fields already fed the villages.
lore.minecraft.shelter_pottery_sherd: A shelter tree. People hid under it from rain and monsters.
lore.minecraft.skull_pottery_sherd: A carved skull. A warning, or a trophy.
lore.minecraft.snort_pottery_sherd: A sniffer drawn by those who knew it.
lore.minecraft.netherite_upgrade_smithin: The bastion smiths' knowledge: it turns diamond into netherite.
lore.minecraft.bolt_armor_trim_smithing_: Lightning-shaped rivets, found in trial vaults.
lore.minecraft.dune_armor_trim_smithing_: The patterns of the desert pyramid builders.
lore.minecraft.eye_armor_trim_smithing_t: A carved eye, brought back from strongholds.
lore.minecraft.flow_armor_trim_smithing_: Wind spirals, the mark of those who beat the breezes.
lore.minecraft.host_armor_trim_smithing_: The patterns of the trail ruins' hosts.
lore.minecraft.raiser_armor_trim_smithin: The ornaments of the forgotten ruins' herders.
lore.minecraft.rib_armor_trim_smithing_t: Carved ribs, brought back from Nether fortresses.
lore.minecraft.shaper_armor_trim_smithin: The ornaments of the trail ruins' builders.
lore.minecraft.silence_armor_trim_smithi: The silence of the ancient city. The rarest of all.
lore.minecraft.snout_armor_trim_smithing: The Piglin snout, proudly carved on armor.
lore.minecraft.spire_armor_trim_smithing: The End city spires, carved in relief.
lore.minecraft.tide_armor_trim_smithing_: The waves of the ocean monuments.
lore.minecraft.vex_armor_trim_smithing_t: Vex wings, brought back from woodland mansions.
lore.minecraft.ward_armor_trim_smithing_: The patterns of the ancient city's wardens.
lore.minecraft.wayfinder_armor_trim_smit: The mark of the trail ruins' wayfinders.
lore.minecraft.wild_armor_trim_smithing_: The wild patterns of jungle temples.
lore.minecraft.creeper_banner_pattern: A creeper on a banner. To scare, or to warn.
lore.minecraft.flower_banner_pattern: A flower on a banner, the emblem of peaceful villages.
lore.minecraft.globe_banner_pattern: A globe on a banner, the explorers' emblem.
lore.minecraft.mojang_banner_pattern: A mysterious symbol, carved by the world's creators.
lore.minecraft.piglin_banner_pattern: A Piglin snout, the banner of the bastions.
lore.minecraft.flow_banner_pattern: A wind spiral, the banner of trial victors.
lore.minecraft.guster_banner_pattern: A breeze's gust on a banner.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_13: A strange disc made of cave noises. You listen to it alone, at night.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_cat: Village cats dance when it plays.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_blocks: A melody that makes you want to build.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_chirp: A tune that smells of summer and birds.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_far: Music for long journeys, when the village is far.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_mall: A calm melody, like a stroll with no goal.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_mellohi: A slow, melancholic tune, for rainy evenings.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_stal: Jazz. In a world of cubes.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_strad: A violin melody that gives courage.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_ward: Music that starts gentle and ends unsettling.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_11: A broken disc. You hear footsteps running away.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_wait: A tune that makes you want to wait for sunrise.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_otherside: A dungeon disc, catchy and mysterious.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_5: Rebuilt from ancient city fragments. Better not listen to it alone.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_relic: A disc found in the trail ruins, full of nostalgia.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_creator: A melody from the trial chambers, grand and windy.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_creator_music_: The same melody, played by a music box. Softer, sadder.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_precipice: Music for the edge of the void, when you hold your breath.
lore.tide.rainbow_trout: Its scales shift color with the light. Village children look for it after the rain.
lore.tide.brook_trout: It only lives in the clearest brooks. Where it swims, the water is safe to drink.
lore.tide.largemouth_bass: A mouth big enough to swallow a duck. It has tried.
lore.tide.white_crappie: Pale as the moon, it hunts when the lake falls asleep.
lore.tide.black_crappie: Its black spots, elders say, are the ink of tales told by the water.
lore.tide.yellow_perch: Easy to catch. Even easier to grill.
lore.tide.carp: It has seen three generations of fishers. It plans to see the fourth.
lore.tide.pike: The tyrant of the reeds. Nothing swims in peace when it is hungry.
lore.tide.guppy: Tiny, colorful, and convinced it is king of the pond.
lore.tide.bluegill: Every fisher's first fish. You never forget it.
lore.tide.catfish: Its whiskers sense everything moving in the mud. Even you.
lore.tide.walleye: It sees your line long before you see your bobber.
lore.tide.arapaima: It breathes air, like you. Sometimes it comes up just to look at you.
lore.tide.mirage_catfish: People swear they saw it in the oases.
lore.tide.sand_tiger_shark: It smiles with all its teeth. It is not being polite.
lore.tide.slimy_salmon: Just holding it is a trial.
lore.tide.frostbite_flounder: It sleeps under the ice. Do not wake it.
lore.tide.sturgeon: A fish older than the mountains.
lore.tide.blossom_bass: It only bites when petals fall on the water.
lore.tide.spore_stalker: It lives in mushroom waters and smells of the undergrowth. Do not eat it raw.
lore.tide.mooneye: It only rises to the surface on full moon nights.
lore.tide.bull_shark: It swims up rivers without asking.
lore.tide.ocean_perch: The open sea perch, red as a sunset over the waves.
lore.tide.red_snapper: Its jaws snap like a trap. Merchants love it.
lore.tide.flounder: It hides in the sand and waits for the world to pass.
lore.tide.anchovy: Alone it is worth nothing. By the thousands it feeds the whole ocean.
lore.tide.tuna: A tireless swimmer. They say it goes around the world every year.
lore.tide.mackerel: Striped like a sailor, always in a school, always in a hurry.
lore.tide.snook: It hunts between the roots, where nets never go.
lore.tide.angelfish: So elegant you hesitate to cook it. You rarely hesitate for long.
lore.tide.mahi_mahi: Its gold and emerald colors fade the moment it leaves the water.
lore.tide.sailfish: A sword for a nose. Delicious anyway.
lore.tide.swordfish: Born armed. Those who underestimated it still bear the scar.
lore.tide.manta_ray: It flies underwater like a bird in the sky, calm and huge.
lore.tide.aquathorn: Covered in thorns, it defends itself better than a hedgehog. Handle it with gloves.
lore.tide.great_white_shark: When it shows up, even the drowned move aside.
lore.tide.neptune_koi: It swims as if floating in the sky.
lore.tide.pluto_snail: The farthest, the smallest, the most forgotten. It keeps moving anyway.
lore.tide.sun_emblem: It shines like a tiny sun. Fishing nights feel warmer with it.
lore.tide.saturn_cuttlefish: Rings of light circle around it. Nobody knows why.
lore.tide.marstilus: Red as Martian dust, it hides in abandoned shells.
lore.tide.uranias_pisces: Astronomers draw it on their sky charts.
lore.tide.shooting_starfish: A star that fell into the sea. Make a wish before you eat it.
lore.tide.coelacanth: Thought extinct for millennia. Nobody told it.
lore.tide.cave_eel: It comes from a place the sun never reached.
lore.tide.cave_crawler: It has legs and no eyes. It finds you anyway.
lore.tide.deep_grouper: Huge and lazy, it waits at the bottom for dinner to come to it.
lore.tide.shadow_snapper: You only notice it when it bites.
lore.tide.glowfish: A small living lantern. Miners keep one at the bottom of their bucket.
lore.tide.anglerfish: A soft light, and behind it, teeth. Never follow the light.
lore.tide.abyss_angler: An even prettier light. Even longer teeth.
lore.tide.iron_tetra: It swallowed so much ore that it ended up rusting.
lore.tide.lapis_lanternfish: Its scales have the color of lapis. Enchanters say it brings luck.
lore.tide.crystal_shrimp: Clear as glass, it lives deep inside amethyst geodes.
lore.tide.dripstone_darter: It darts between stalactites faster than a falling drop.
lore.tide.luminescent_jellyfish: It floats in the dark like a ghost of light. Do not touch it bare-handed.
lore.tide.crystalline_carp: A carp that ate so many crystals it became one.
lore.tide.gilded_minnow: A minnow flecked with gold. Gold panners follow it to find veins.
lore.tide.bedrock_tetra: It lives at the very bottom, against the world's bedrock. Nothing lives deeper.
lore.tide.chasm_eel: It lives where ropes do not reach.
lore.tide.echo_snapper: It mimics the sound of what it eats. In the ancient city, that is very unsettling.
lore.tide.windbass: It swims in the trial chambers' air, carried by the gusts.
lore.tide.devils_hole_pupfish: The rarest fish in the world, in the deepest hole.
lore.tide.midas_fish: Everything it touches turns to gold. Greedy fishers always end badly.
lore.tide.bedrock_bug: A small critter gnawing at the world's bedrock. It is not done yet.
lore.tide.sleepy_carp: It sleeps so much it bites the hook without waking up.
lore.tide.blue_neonfish: With it, fishing nights look like a party.
lore.tide.deep_blue: Looking at it, you get a little lost.
lore.tide.nephrosilu: Nobody can pronounce its name. Neither can it.
lore.tide.pentapus: Five arms, not one more. It thinks that is plenty.
lore.tide.darkness_eater: Around it, the night is brighter.
lore.tide.shadow_shark: A shadow with teeth. You never see it coming.
lore.tide.alpha_fish: The others move aside when it passes.
lore.tide.magma_mackerel: It swims in lava like others swim in water. It comes already cooked.
lore.tide.ember_koi: An ember carp. Nether smiths keep it as a lucky charm.
lore.tide.ash_perch: Covered in ash, it lives in the basalt deltas' pools.
lore.tide.obsidian_pike: Hard as obsidian, and just as sharp.
lore.tide.volcano_tuna: A tuna raised inside a volcano. It is always a little angry.
lore.tide.inferno_guppy: Small, burning hot, and very proud of it.
lore.tide.warped_guppy: It has the color of the warped forests. And their smell.
lore.tide.soulscale: At night, you can hear its scales whisper.
lore.tide.blazing_swordfish: A swordfish on fire: a weapon and a hot meal at the same time.
lore.tide.pale_clubfish: Pale as a forgotten garden, with a club for a head.
lore.tide.amber_rockfish: A fish trapped in amber for centuries, and back to life.
lore.tide.chorus_cod: It shows up where you least expect it.
lore.tide.ender_glider: It glides between the End islands like a leaf in the wind.
lore.tide.endergazer: Do not look it in the eye. It does not like that.
lore.tide.violet_carp: Violet as the End sky, it swims in perfect silence.
lore.tide.red_40: That red cannot be natural. Eat it anyway.
lore.tide.dutchman_sock: The Flying Dutchman's sock. How did it get here?
lore.tide.elytrout: A trout that stole elytra. It swims through the sky, above the void.
lore.tide.mantyvern: Half ray, half dragon. It spits burning bubbles.
lore.tide.snatcher_squid: It steals bait without ever biting.
lore.tide.voidseeker: It swims at the edge of the void and looks in. The void looks back.
lore.tide.dragon_fish: Some fishers search for it all their lives.
lore.tide.fish_slice: A thin slice, ready to grill over a campfire.
lore.tide.cooked_fish: A grilled fish, the reward for a long day by the water.
lore.tide.cooked_fish_slice: A grilled slice, crispy outside, tender inside.
lore.tide.small_cooked_fish: Small but cooked just right. Enough to last until the next village.
lore.tide.large_cooked_fish: Enough to feed a whole table. The fisher earned their share.
lore.tide.grilled_tuna: A slice of grilled tuna, the sailors' favorite dish.
lore.tide.fish_bone: All that is left of a good meal. Cats will not say no.
lore.tide.stone_fishing_rod: A heavy, rustic rod. It does not break, it just gets tired.
lore.tide.iron_fishing_rod: Sturdy and reliable, the rod of those who fish every day.
lore.tide.golden_fishing_rod: It draws luck, and a few jealous looks.
lore.tide.diamond_fishing_rod: The master fishers' rod. Big fish fear it.
lore.tide.netherite_fishing_rod: It withstands lava. The Nether is no longer a limit for fishing.
lore.tide.blazing_fishing_rod: A rod of flames, made to fish in lava lakes.
lore.tide.crystal_fishing_rod: Carved from crystal. It sings when a fish bites.
lore.tide.echo_fishing_rod: The rod of resonance: it hears fish before they bite.
lore.tide.midas_fishing_rod: Everything it reels in shines a little more.
lore.tide.prismarine_fishing_rod: Forged from the monument's prismarine. The sea recognizes it.
lore.tide.village_fishing_rod: A gift from the villagers, for their hero.
lore.tide.honeycomb_fishing_rod: A straight line to the fish, like a bee to its flower.
lore.tide.sunflower_fishing_rod: It turns toward the sun. Daytime fish love it.
lore.tide.fishing_line: A simple thread, but it is what brings dinner home.
lore.tide.copper_line: A copper wire, stronger than string and a little conductive.
lore.tide.iron_line: An iron line. Big fish no longer snap it.
lore.tide.golden_line: A golden line that shines underwater and draws the curious.
lore.tide.diamond_line: A line nothing can cut, not even a shark's teeth.
lore.tide.fishing_hook: A simple hook. What matters most is patience.
lore.tide.lavaproof_hook: A hook that does not melt. Essential for lava fishing.
lore.tide.fiery_hook: A burning hook that cooks the fish as it bites.
lore.tide.permafrost_hook: A frozen hook that lulls cold water fish to sleep.
lore.tide.twilight_hook: A hook that only shines at dusk, the hour of rare fish.
lore.tide.void_hook: The hook of the depths. It sinks below the bottom.
lore.tide.bait: Simple bait. Fish are not picky.
lore.tide.lucky_bait: A lucky bait. Rare fish have a soft spot for it.
lore.tide.magnetic_bait: It draws treasure as much as fish.
lore.tide.abyss_bait: A bait that glows in the dark of the abyss.
lore.tide.incandescent_bait: A burning bait for lava fish.
lore.tide.fish_satchel: A satchel that keeps fish fresh for the whole trip.
lore.tide.fishing_journal: The fisher's notebook: every fish, every place, every story.
lore.tide.fishy_note: A crumpled note that smells of fish. Someone wrote a secret in it.
lore.tide.fish_finder: It beeps when a school passes. Old fishers call it cheating.
lore.tide.climate_gauge: It tells the weather underwater. Fish already know.
lore.tide.depth_meter: It tells how deep you are fishing. The lower, the stranger.
lore.tide.pocket_watch: A pocket watch: some fish only bite at a precise hour.
lore.tide.enchanted_pocket_watch: It tells the time of every world at once.
lore.tide.obsidian_fragment: A shard of obsidian brought up from lava, sharp as a blade.
lore.tide.starlight_bow: A bow drawn from the light of shooting stars. Its arrows fall from the sky.
lore.tide.dragonfin_boots: Boots made of dragon fish fins. You swim as you walk.
lore.tide.fishing_bobber: The red and white bobber of every fisher.
lore.tide.light_gray_bobber: Light gray as a misty morning.
lore.tide.brown_bobber: Brown as the mud where carps sleep.
lore.tide.orange_bobber: Orange as a sunset over the lake.
lore.tide.yellow_bobber: Yellow as a sunbeam on the water.
lore.tide.lime_bobber: Lime green, it makes frogs laugh.
lore.tide.light_blue_bobber: Light blue as a summer sky.
lore.tide.magenta_bobber: Magenta, for fishers who want to be seen.
lore.tide.amethyst_bobber: Carved from amethyst, it chimes when it moves.
lore.tide.apple_bobber: A floating apple. Fish find it tasty.
lore.tide.golden_apple_bobber: A golden apple as a bobber. What a waste, what style.
lore.tide.enchanted_golden_apple_bobber: The most precious bobber in the world. Do not lose it.
lore.tide.chorus_bobber: A chorus fruit that floats, and sometimes vanishes.
lore.tide.duck_bobber: A little duck. Children love fishing with it.
lore.tide.echo_bobber: It echoes underwater like in the ancient city.
lore.tide.feather_bobber: Light as a feather, because it is one.
lore.tide.golden_bobber: A golden bobber for fishers who made it.
lore.tide.grassy_bobber: A floating tuft of grass. Perfect camouflage.
lore.tide.heart_bobber: A little heart, to fish with love.
lore.tide.iron_bobber: An iron bobber. It floats. Do not ask how.
lore.tide.lichen_bobber: Covered in lichen, as if it had been fishing forever.
lore.tide.nautilus_bobber: A nautilus shell dancing on the waves.
lore.tide.netherite_bobber: A netherite bobber. It does not even fear lava.
lore.tide.pearl_bobber: A floating pearl, for luxury fishing.
lore.tide.diamond_bobber: A diamond at the end of the line. Fish could not care less.
lore.create.andesite_alloy: Andesite mixed with iron, neither pretty nor precious. But without it, no machine turns.
lore.create.attribute_filter: A filter that judges items by what they are, not by their name. Slip it into a funnel or a tunnel.
lore.create.bar_of_chocolate: Chocolate poured into a bar, still warm from the vat. Engineers always keep one in their pocket.
lore.create.belt_connector: A rubber belt to stretch between two shafts. Whatever you set on it moves along, never tiring.
lore.create.blaze_cake: A cake only a blaze could love. Feed it to a burner and it flares up for real.
lore.create.blaze_cake_base: A batter still waiting for its fiery filling. Not a cake yet, already dangerous.
lore.create.brass_hand: A brass hand with jointed fingers. It can't do anything alone, but it learns quickly.
lore.create.brass_ingot: Copper and zinc melted together. The metal of machines that think.
lore.create.brass_nugget: A brass nugget, enough to tune a small mechanism.
lore.create.brass_sheet: A sheet of pressed brass. It shines like a workshop's promise.
lore.create.builders_tea: Strong, sweet tea served on building sites. After a cup, blocks almost place themselves.
lore.create.cardboard: Neatly folded cardboard, light and obliging. Every parcel in the kingdom is made of it.
lore.create.cardboard_boots: Cardboard boots. They hold up until the first puddle.
lore.create.cardboard_chestplate: A cardboard armor, taped together with love. Nobody believes in it, but it makes people laugh.
lore.create.cardboard_helmet: A cardboard helmet, cut with a knife. Village children dream of one.
lore.create.cardboard_leggings: Cardboard leggings that creak with every step. Zero stealth.
lore.create.cardboard_sword: A cardboard sword. It cuts nothing, but nobody wants to be hit by it anyway.
lore.create.chest_minecart_contraption: A machine folded into a minecart along with its chest. It waits to be set back on the rails.
lore.create.chocolate_bucket: A bucket full of melted chocolate. Resisting it takes character.
lore.create.chocolate_glazed_berries: Berries dipped in chocolate. The kind of treat you eat by the handful.
lore.create.chromatic_compound: A substance undecided between every color. Light or shadow will decide what it becomes.
lore.create.cinder_flour: Flour milled from netherrack. It smells of sulfur and heat.
lore.create.copper_backtank_placeable: A pressurized air tank, set on the ground. It fills up while everything turns.
lore.create.copper_diving_boots: Copper-weighted boots. Underwater, they keep your feet on the seabed.
lore.create.copper_diving_helmet: A copper diving helmet. With a tank on your back, the ocean becomes a workshop.
lore.create.copper_nugget: A copper nugget. Nine of them, and you're back to an ingot.
lore.create.copper_sheet: A pressed copper sheet. It will turn green with time, like every roof in the kingdom.
lore.create.crafter_slot_cover: A small cover that seals a crafter's slot. Nothing goes through, nothing is missing.
lore.create.crafting_blueprint: A blueprint pinned to the wall. It remembers a recipe and applies it flawlessly.
lore.create.creative_blaze_cake: A cake that never ends. The burner that eats it will never go out again.
lore.create.crushed_raw_aluminum: Crushed aluminum, ready to be washed or smelted. More metal, less effort.
lore.create.crushed_raw_copper: Crushed copper ore. Washed, it even gives back a few extra nuggets.
lore.create.crushed_raw_gold: Gold crushed into grains. Gold panners wash it with patience.
lore.create.crushed_raw_iron: Iron crushed by the wheels. You get more from it than by smelting it as is.
lore.create.crushed_raw_lead: Crushed lead, heavy in the hand. Handle it with gloves.
lore.create.crushed_raw_nickel: Crushed nickel, a soft gray. It will end up in a sturdy alloy.
lore.create.crushed_raw_osmium: Crushed osmium, dense as a secret. Few forges know what to do with it.
lore.create.crushed_raw_platinum: Crushed platinum. Even as dust, it's worth a fortune.
lore.create.crushed_raw_quicksilver: Crushed quicksilver that seems to flow between your fingers. Keep it away from your mouth.
lore.create.crushed_raw_silver: Crushed silver, already gleaming. Werewolves don't like it.
lore.create.crushed_raw_tin: Crushed tin, humble but useful. Without it, no bronze.
lore.create.crushed_raw_uranium: Crushed uranium. It's warm, and that's not a good sign.
lore.create.crushed_raw_zinc: Crushed zinc, the first step toward brass.
lore.create.dough: A soft dough, kneaded by a machine. It waits for the oven.
lore.create.electron_tube: A glass bulb that holds a spark. It's what gives machines a little sense.
lore.create.empty_blaze_burner: An empty iron cage, made for a blaze. All that's left is to catch one.
lore.create.empty_schematic: A blank parchment, ready to hold the plans of an entire build.
lore.create.experience_nugget: Solidified experience, warm to the touch. Crush it and you learn something.
lore.create.extendo_grip: A jointed arm that extends your hand. Distant blocks come within reach.
lore.create.filter: A list of allowed items. Slipped into a funnel, it sorts things for you.
lore.create.furnace_minecart_contraption: A machine folded into a furnace minecart. It moves on its own, as long as you feed it.
lore.create.goggles: Engineer's goggles. With them, every machine tells you how it feels.
lore.create.golden_sheet: A pressed gold sheet, thin as paper. Nothing more elegant to finish a machine.
lore.create.handheld_worldshaper: A tool that shapes the world with a gesture. It belongs only to creative builders.
lore.create.honey_bucket: A bucket of thick golden honey. It flows slowly, like a summer afternoon.
lore.create.honeyed_apple: An apple dipped in honey. The village bees are proud of you.
lore.create.incomplete_precision_mechani: A half-assembled mechanism. A few more steps, and it will count turns to the tenth.
lore.create.incomplete_track: A track not yet finished. It still needs its fastenings to carry a train.
lore.create.iron_sheet: A pressed iron plate, sturdy and simple. The basis of every casing.
lore.create.linked_controller: A controller linked to distant signals. One key, and a machine wakes up across the village.
lore.create.minecart_contraption: A machine folded into a minecart. Set it back on rails to bring it to life.
lore.create.minecart_coupling: A chain to hitch two minecarts. They'll travel together.
lore.create.netherite_backtank_placeable: A netherite air tank, set on the ground. It fears neither lava nor time.
lore.create.netherite_diving_boots: Netherite diving boots. They walk the bottom of oceans as easily as lava lakes.
lore.create.netherite_diving_helmet: A netherite diving helmet. Even lava no longer blinds you.
lore.create.package_filter: A filter that reads parcel addresses. Every package finds its way.
lore.create.polished_rose_quartz: Rose quartz polished until clear. It carries signals like a thought.
lore.create.potato_cannon: An air cannon that fires vegetables. Ridiculous until a potato hits you in the face.
lore.create.powdered_obsidian: Obsidian ground to powder. The hardest stone, beaten by a millstone.
lore.create.precision_mechanism: A watchmaker's mechanism, tiny and perfect. The finest machines depend on it.
lore.create.propeller: A metal propeller, ready to stir the air. In a fan, it blows to the far end of the room.
lore.create.pulp: A paste of wet fibers. Pressed and dried, it becomes cardboard.
lore.create.raw_zinc: Raw zinc, dull and lumpy. Smelted, it will shine.
lore.create.red_sand_paper: Red sand paper, more abrasive. It polishes without mercy.
lore.create.refined_radiance: Light made solid. It shines even in the deepest dark.
lore.create.rose_quartz: A rose-tinted quartz, fed with redstone. Still rough, already promising.
lore.create.sand_paper: Sand paper, for polishing by hand. Slow, but satisfying.
lore.create.schedule: A train schedule, written by hand. Trains follow it better than passengers do.
lore.create.schematic: The complete plan of a build. A schematicannon will rebuild it stone by stone.
lore.create.schematic_and_quill: A quill and parchment to record a build. Pick two corners, and it's yours.
lore.create.shadow_steel: A metal that drinks light. It's cold, smooth and a little unsettling.
lore.create.shopping_list: A shopping list for the parcel network. Just take it to the counter.
lore.create.sturdy_sheet: A compressed obsidian sheet, nearly unbreakable. It protects what needs protecting.
lore.create.super_glue: A glue that holds everything. Glued blocks travel together when a machine moves.
lore.create.sweet_roll: A sweet rolled bun. Workshops smell nice in the morning.
lore.create.transmitter: A small transmitter that whispers signals from afar.
lore.create.tree_fertilizer: A powerful tree fertilizer. Even small saplings grow into giants.
lore.create.unprocessed_obsidian_sheet: An obsidian sheet not yet pressed. One more pass under the press.
lore.create.vertical_gearbox: A gearbox turned on its side. Rotation changes direction without losing strength.
lore.create.wand_of_symmetry: A wand that mirrors your actions. Place a block, its twin appears on the other side.
lore.create.wheat_flour: Fine white wheat flour. The beginning of every loaf.
lore.create.whisk: A metal kitchen whisk. In a mixer, it beats whatever it's given.
lore.create.wrench: The engineer's wrench. It turns, adjusts and dismantles anything with gears.
lore.create.zinc_ingot: A zinc ingot, gray and modest. Alloyed with copper, it becomes brass.
lore.create.zinc_nugget: A zinc nugget. Not much, but small things add up.
lore.create.adjustable_chain_gearshift: A chain drive whose speed follows signal strength. The stronger the current, the faster it turns.
lore.create.analog_lever: A graduated lever, from 0 to 15. For those who find on and off too simple.
lore.create.basin: A metal basin for mixing and compacting. The wildest recipes start here.
lore.create.blaze_burner: A caged blaze, fed by hand. It heats whatever sits above it, with more or less enthusiasm.
lore.create.bound_cardboard_block: Stacked, tied-up cardboard. Light, but it makes a fine mover's wall.
lore.create.brass_block: A block of polished brass. Wealthy workshops make shining floors from it.
lore.create.brass_encased_cogwheel: A cogwheel enclosed in brass. Cleaner, quieter, just as effective.
lore.create.brass_encased_large_cogwheel: A large cogwheel under a brass casing. It changes speed without showing its teeth.
lore.create.brass_encased_shaft: A drive shaft dressed in brass. It passes through walls with elegance.
lore.create.brass_funnel: A brass funnel that can count. It takes exactly what you ask for.
lore.create.brass_table_cloth: A brass-embroidered tablecloth. Lay it on a table, and the shop is open.
lore.create.brass_tunnel: A brass tunnel over a belt. It distributes items with strict politeness.
lore.create.cardboard_block: A compact cardboard block. It burns well and carries even better.
lore.create.cart_assembler: A rail that mounts a machine onto a minecart. The cart then carries the whole build.
lore.create.chain_conveyor: A suspended chain conveyor, carrying parcels above everyone's heads.
lore.create.chute: A metal chute where items fall straight down. Simple, and almost foolproof.
lore.create.clipboard: A clipboard to jot down your tasks. Engineers forget everything else.
lore.create.clockwork_bearing: A bearing that turns like a clock hand. Build a dial, and it will tell the time.
lore.create.clutch: A clutch that cuts rotation as soon as it gets a signal.
lore.create.cogwheel: A small wooden cogwheel. Every factory starts with one tooth pushing another.
lore.create.content_observer: A clever observer that watches what goes by. It lights up when the right item arrives.
lore.create.contraption_controls: A dashboard for moving machines. Switch off whatever you no longer want running.
lore.create.controller_rail: A rail whose signal strength sets the speed of minecarts.
lore.create.controls: A train's driving seat. Take your place, and the line is yours.
lore.create.copper_backtank: A copper air tank worn on your back. It feeds diving helmets and pressurized tools.
lore.create.copper_table_cloth: A copper-toned tablecloth, for humbler stalls.
lore.create.copper_valve_handle: A copper valve handle. Turn it by hand to move a machine, gently.
lore.create.copycat_panel: A panel that takes on the look of any block you give it. A builder's chameleon.
lore.create.copycat_step: A copycat step. It disguises itself as any material.
lore.create.creative_crate: A bottomless crate. It gives as much as you ask, forever.
lore.create.creative_fluid_tank: A tank that never empties. An engineer's dream, reserved for creative builders.
lore.create.creative_motor: A motor that turns endlessly without fuel. Nobody knows how.
lore.create.crushing_wheel: A huge wheel that crushes whatever passes between it and its twin. You always need two.
lore.create.cuckoo_clock: A carved wooden cuckoo clock. The little bird announces bedtime.
lore.create.deployer: A mechanical hand that uses items like a player. It places, hits and picks up without tiring.
lore.create.depot: A tray to set an item on so a machine can work on it.
lore.create.desk_bell: A small counter bell. One ring, and someone comes.
lore.create.display_board: A large display board. It shows the information sent by a display link.
lore.create.display_link: A link that reads a machine and writes it on a board. Factories love being talked about.
lore.create.elevator_contact: A contact that marks a floor for the elevator.
lore.create.elevator_pulley: An elevator pulley. It lifts and lowers a cabin between floors.
lore.create.encased_chain_drive: A cased chain drive. It carries rotation sideways.
lore.create.encased_fan: A fan in its housing. It blows, pulls, and processes items through fire or water.
lore.create.experience_block: Experience pressed into a block. A whole body of knowledge, ready to be reclaimed.
lore.create.factory_gauge: A factory gauge that watches stock levels and orders what's missing.
lore.create.fluid_pipe: A copper pipe to move fluids around. A pump gets it flowing.
lore.create.fluid_tank: A fluid tank you can expand. The more you stack, the more it holds.
lore.create.fluid_valve: A valve that opens or closes when its shaft turns.
lore.create.flywheel: A heavy, steady flywheel. It turns with the patience of great machines.
lore.create.framed_glass: Glass set in a metal frame. Workshops like to see daylight.
lore.create.framed_glass_pane: A framed pane, for factory windows.
lore.create.framed_glass_trapdoor: A glass trapdoor. You see what's below before opening it.
lore.create.gantry_carriage: A carriage that slides along a gantry. It carries whatever is glued to it.
lore.create.gantry_shaft: A gantry shaft a carriage rides on. Turn it, and the carriage moves.
lore.create.gearbox: A gearbox that sends rotation in every direction.
lore.create.gearshift: A reverser: one signal, and rotation changes direction.
lore.create.hand_crank: A crank turned by hand. The first engine is you.
lore.create.haunted_bell: A bell that tolls for the dead. It reveals where monsters can spawn.
lore.create.horizontal_framed_glass: Glass with horizontal frames, for a greenhouse look.
lore.create.hose_pulley: A pulley that unrolls a hose to drain or fill a whole lake.
lore.create.industrial_iron_block: A riveted, austere block of industrial iron. The decor of serious factories.
lore.create.item_drain: A grate that drains items of their fluid. A water bucket leaves its contents there.
lore.create.item_hatch: A hatch to empty your inventory into storage in one click.
lore.create.item_vault: A giant, expandable vault. It isn't looted, it's built.
lore.create.large_cogwheel: A large cogwheel. Paired with a small one, it doubles or halves the speed.
lore.create.large_water_wheel: A large water wheel, slower but stronger. The river does the work.
lore.create.linear_chassis: A chassis that carries aligned blocks when the machine moves.
lore.create.mechanical_arm: A jointed arm that takes from here and drops there. It never picks the wrong slot.
lore.create.mechanical_bearing: A bearing that spins whatever is attached to it. Doors, mills, carousels.
lore.create.mechanical_crafter: A mechanical crafter. Several together build even the largest recipes.
lore.create.mechanical_drill: A drill that digs whatever is in front of it. Lazy miners love it.
lore.create.mechanical_harvester: A harvester that reaps ripe crops as it passes, and lets them grow back.
lore.create.mechanical_mixer: A mixer that churns a basin's contents. Doughs, alloys, potions.
lore.create.mechanical_piston: A piston that pushes whole builds, as far as its poles allow.
lore.create.mechanical_plough: A plough that tills and breaks whatever is in its way.
lore.create.mechanical_press: A press that flattens ingots into sheets. A dull, steady, reassuring thud.
lore.create.mechanical_pump: A pump that pushes fluids through pipes.
lore.create.mechanical_roller: A roller that flattens and paves the ground beneath a moving machine.
lore.create.mechanical_saw: A saw that fells trees and cuts timber. Mind your fingers.
lore.create.metal_bracket: A metal bracket to dress up a drive shaft.
lore.create.metal_girder: A metal girder, for bridges and steel frames.
lore.create.millstone: A stone millstone that grinds slowly. Grain becomes flour, stone becomes sand.
lore.create.mysterious_cuckoo_clock: A cuckoo clock that doesn't chime like the others. Best not to be around at midnight.
lore.create.netherite_backtank: A netherite air tank. It resists fire and lasts twice as long.
lore.create.nixie_tube: A glowing tube that shows a digit or a word. A warm, nostalgic glow.
lore.create.nozzle: A nozzle that spreads a fan's airflow all around it.
lore.create.package_frogport: A mechanical frog that swallows parcels and spits them out in the right place.
lore.create.packager: A machine that wraps items into parcels, ready to ship.
lore.create.peculiar_bell: A strange bell, waiting only for a little soul fire to wake.
lore.create.piston_extension_pole: An extension for a mechanical piston. Each pole pushes it one block farther.
lore.create.placard: A small wall frame that shows an item and lights up when the same one is inserted.
lore.create.portable_fluid_interface: An interface that swaps fluids with a moving machine.
lore.create.portable_storage_interface: An interface that empties or fills the chests of a passing machine.
lore.create.powered_latch: A redstone latch: it remembers the last signal it got.
lore.create.powered_toggle_latch: A toggle latch: every pulse flips its state.
lore.create.pulse_extender: A pulse extender. A short signal becomes one that lasts.
lore.create.pulse_repeater: A repeater that turns a steady signal into a single pulse, after a delay.
lore.create.pulse_timer: A timer that emits regular pulses, like a machine's heartbeat.
lore.create.radial_chassis: A chassis that carries the blocks around it when the machine moves.
lore.create.raw_zinc_block: A block of raw zinc, still full of dirt.
lore.create.redstone_contact: A contact that lights up when it touches its twin. Perfect for moving doors.
lore.create.redstone_link: A wireless redstone link. Two frequencies, and the signal goes through walls.
lore.create.redstone_requester: A requester that places an order on the network when it gets a signal.
lore.create.repackager: A machine that reopens parcels and repacks them neatly.
lore.create.rope_pulley: A rope pulley that raises and lowers blocks like a winch.
lore.create.rose_quartz_block: A rose quartz block, warm and bright.
lore.create.rose_quartz_lamp: A rose quartz lamp that switches on and off with each signal.
lore.create.rotation_speed_controller: A controller that sets the exact speed of rotation.
lore.create.sail_frame: A sail frame for a windmill. It catches the wind without taking any color.
lore.create.schematic_table: A table to copy and upload building plans.
lore.create.schematicannon: A cannon that fires blocks into place until a whole plan is rebuilt.
lore.create.secondary_linear_chassis: A secondary linear chassis, to keep two groups of blocks from sticking together.
lore.create.sequenced_gearshift: A programmable gearshift: it turns, stops and restarts following a list of instructions.
lore.create.shaft: A simple drive shaft. Rotation passes from one end to the other.
lore.create.smart_chute: A chute that sorts what falls through, according to its filter.
lore.create.smart_fluid_pipe: A pipe that only lets the chosen fluid through.
lore.create.speedometer: A speedometer. It tells how fast the machine is turning.
lore.create.spout: A spout that fills the items below it. Bottles, buckets, and more.
lore.create.steam_engine: A loud, powerful steam engine. With a good boiler, it runs an entire factory.
lore.create.steam_whistle: A steam whistle. The song of work beginning.
lore.create.sticker: A sticky block that grabs or releases the block in front on a signal.
lore.create.sticky_mechanical_piston: A sticky mechanical piston. It pushes, then pulls back what it pushed.
lore.create.stock_link: A link that connects storage to the parcel network.
lore.create.stock_ticker: A counter that shows the network's stock and takes orders.
lore.create.stockpile_switch: A switch that triggers when storage gets too full or too empty.
lore.create.stressometer: A stress gauge. It warns you before the gears give out.
lore.create.track: A train track. Lay enough of it, and the kingdom fits on a single line.
lore.create.track_observer: A track observer: it lights up when a train goes by.
lore.create.track_signal: A railway signal. It keeps two trains from meeting too soon.
lore.create.track_station: A train station. Trains stop, get assembled and named there.
lore.create.train_trapdoor: A train trapdoor, so you don't fall between two carriages.
lore.create.turntable: A turntable that spins whatever stands on it. Cows hate it.
lore.create.water_wheel: A water wheel. Put it in the current, and the river works for you.
lore.create.weathered_iron_block: Iron worn by the years. It tells of abandoned factories.
lore.create.weighted_ejector: A plate that launches items and creatures toward a chosen target.
lore.create.windmill_bearing: A windmill bearing. Attach sails, and the wind does the rest.
lore.create.wooden_bracket: A wooden bracket to dress up a drive shaft.
lore.create.zinc_block: A block of zinc, gray and solid.
lore.create.zinc_ore: Zinc ore, hidden in the rock. The first step toward brass.
lore.farmersdelight.apple_cider: A sweet sparkling cider, pressed in the kingdom's orchards.
lore.farmersdelight.apple_pie_slice: A slice of apple pie, still warm. It smells of cinnamon and home.
lore.farmersdelight.bacon: A raw slice of bacon. All it needs is a pan and a little patience.
lore.farmersdelight.bacon_and_eggs: The breakfast of early adventurers. Greasy, hot, perfect.
lore.farmersdelight.bacon_sandwich: A crispy bacon sandwich. Night guards swear by it.
lore.farmersdelight.baked_cod_stew: An oven-baked cod stew that warms you to the fingertips.
lore.farmersdelight.barbecue_stick: A skewer grilled over the campfire. It tastes like nights under the stars.
lore.farmersdelight.beef_patty: A grilled beef patty. All it's missing is a bun.
lore.farmersdelight.beef_stew: A beef stew simmering since dawn. Enough to last a day of ploughing.
lore.farmersdelight.bone_broth: A clear, comforting bone broth. Nothing is wasted in the kitchen.
lore.farmersdelight.cabbage: A firm, crisp, fresh cabbage. The basis of every peasant soup.
lore.farmersdelight.cabbage_leaf: A loose cabbage leaf, ready to wrap something good.
lore.farmersdelight.cabbage_rolls: Rolled, stuffed cabbage leaves. A grandmother's recipe.
lore.farmersdelight.cabbage_seeds: Cabbage seeds. Village gardens always need them.
lore.farmersdelight.cake_slice: A slice of cake. You only share it with real friends.
lore.farmersdelight.canvas: A sturdy canvas, woven from straw. It makes good signs and good rugs.
lore.farmersdelight.chicken_cuts: Raw chicken pieces, cut with a knife. They're waiting for the pan.
lore.farmersdelight.chicken_sandwich: A chicken sandwich, simple and generous.
lore.farmersdelight.chicken_soup: A chicken soup, every mother's remedy since forever.
lore.farmersdelight.chocolate_pie_slice: A slice of chocolate pie, so rich one is enough. Almost.
lore.farmersdelight.cod_roll: Cod rolled in rice and seaweed. A recipe from across the sea.
lore.farmersdelight.cod_slice: A raw cod fillet, clean and fresh.
lore.farmersdelight.cooked_bacon: Bacon grilled until it crackles. The sound alone makes you hungry.
lore.farmersdelight.cooked_chicken_cuts: Golden chicken pieces, to eat with your fingers.
lore.farmersdelight.cooked_cod_slice: A cooked cod fillet, white and tender.
lore.farmersdelight.cooked_mutton_chops: Grilled mutton chops, simple and tasty.
lore.farmersdelight.cooked_rice: A plain bowl of cooked rice. The basis of a thousand meals.
lore.farmersdelight.cooked_salmon_slice: A cooked salmon fillet, pink and tender.
lore.farmersdelight.diamond_knife: A diamond-bladed knife. It cuts vegetables and enemies with the same precision.
lore.farmersdelight.dog_food: Dog food. Your wolf will stay loyal, and get a little stronger.
lore.farmersdelight.dumplings: Steamed dumplings, stuffed with meat and vegetables.
lore.farmersdelight.egg_sandwich: An egg sandwich, the snack of hurried travelers.
lore.farmersdelight.fish_stew: A fish stew that smells of harbors and nets.
lore.farmersdelight.flint_knife: A knapped flint knife. Crude, but it cuts meat and straw.
lore.farmersdelight.fried_egg: A fried egg, yellow and runny.
lore.farmersdelight.fried_rice: Rice fried with egg and vegetables. You always eat one bowl too many.
lore.farmersdelight.fruit_salad: A colorful fruit salad, fresh as a summer morning.
lore.farmersdelight.gleaming_salad: A salad of glistering melon slices. It heals as much as it feeds.
lore.farmersdelight.glow_berry_custard: A custard made with glow berries. It glows a little in the bowl.
lore.farmersdelight.golden_knife: A golden knife, prettier than useful. Noble cooks adore it.
lore.farmersdelight.grilled_salmon: A salmon grilled with herbs. The dish of big nights at the harbor.
lore.farmersdelight.ham: A whole raw ham. Enough to feed a family once cooked.
lore.farmersdelight.hamburger: A full burger. Meat, lettuce, tomato, onion: nothing is missing.
lore.farmersdelight.honey_cookie: A honey cookie, crisp and golden.
lore.farmersdelight.honey_glazed_ham: A plate of honey-glazed ham. A feast dish.
lore.farmersdelight.horse_feed: A grain mix for horses. Mounts always ask for more.
lore.farmersdelight.hot_cocoa: A steaming hot cocoa. It chases away the cold and bad thoughts.
lore.farmersdelight.iron_knife: An iron knife, every kitchen's tool. It also works for self-defense.
lore.farmersdelight.kelp_roll: A kelp roll filled with rice. Cut it into slices to share.
lore.farmersdelight.kelp_roll_slice: A slice of kelp roll, a mouthful of sea.
lore.farmersdelight.melon_juice: A fresh melon juice, pressed by hand.
lore.farmersdelight.melon_popsicle: A melon popsicle. It melts faster than you can eat it.
lore.farmersdelight.milk_bottle: A bottle of milk, handier than a bucket. It clears potion effects just as well.
lore.farmersdelight.minced_beef: Raw minced beef, ready to become patties or meatballs.
lore.farmersdelight.mixed_salad: A mixed salad, crisp and light.
lore.farmersdelight.mushroom_rice: Mushroom rice, fragrant with the forest floor.
lore.farmersdelight.mutton_wrap: A flatbread wrapped around grilled mutton. A shepherd's meal.
lore.farmersdelight.nether_salad: A salad of Nether fungi. It takes a brave stomach.
lore.farmersdelight.netherite_knife: A netherite knife. It barely ever dulls, even on bone.
lore.farmersdelight.noodle_soup: A steaming noodle soup, to slurp noisily.
lore.farmersdelight.onion: An onion. It makes those who cut it cry, and those who eat it smile.
lore.farmersdelight.onion_soup: A gratinéed onion soup. The cure for hard mornings.
lore.farmersdelight.pasta_with_meatballs: Pasta with meatballs and tomato sauce. The dish that brings the table together.
lore.farmersdelight.pasta_with_mutton_ch: Pasta served with a mutton chop. Hearty and rustic.
lore.farmersdelight.pie_crust: A pie crust, ready for its filling.
lore.farmersdelight.pumpkin_pie_slice: A slice of pumpkin pie, spiced like autumn.
lore.farmersdelight.pumpkin_slice: A raw pumpkin slice, orange and firm.
lore.farmersdelight.pumpkin_soup: A velvety pumpkin soup, soft and warm.
lore.farmersdelight.ratatouille: A long-simmered ratatouille. The garden's vegetables, together at last.
lore.farmersdelight.rice_panicle: A rice panicle, to plant in water or thresh.

lore.farmersdelight.onion_crate: A crate of onions. It stings the eyes a little.

lore.farmersdelight.roast_chicken_block: A whole roast chicken, ready to be carved.

lore.farmersdelight.stove: A brick stove. It heats the pot and grills whatever is set on it.
lore.farmersdelight.straw_bale: A straw bale. Cats love hiding in it.

lore.mowziesmobs.bluff_rod: A rod carved to deceive. Those who hold it lie a little better.
lore.mowziesmobs.captured_grottol: A captured grottol, still wriggling. It eats diamonds, so watch your chest.
lore.mowziesmobs.dart: A poison-coated dart, for the blowgun.

lore.mowziesmobs.elokosa_paw_full: The paw of the full moon. The strongest, and the hungriest.

lore.mowziesmobs.elokosa_paw_half: The paw of the half moon, torn between shadow and light.
lore.mowziesmobs.elokosa_paw_new: The paw of the new moon, cold and silent. It waits.

lore.mowziesmobs.geomancer_belt: A geomancer's belt, weighted with carved stones.
lore.mowziesmobs.geomancer_robe: A geomancer's robe, the color of rock. It smells of cave dust.
lore.mowziesmobs.geomancer_sandals: A geomancer's sandals. They never slip on stone.
lore.mowziesmobs.glowing_jelly: A luminous jelly taken from a cave lantern. It glows, and it heals.
lore.mowziesmobs.grant_suns_blessing: The sun's blessing, granted by a defeated Umvuthi. Its light goes with you.
lore.mowziesmobs.ice_crystal: An ice crystal torn from the Frostmaw. It breathes the cold of endless winter.
lore.mowziesmobs.mob_remover: A builder's tool that makes a creature vanish. Nothing very glorious.

lore.mowziesmobs.naga_fang_dagger: A dagger carved from a naga fang. Struck from behind, it shows no mercy.
lore.mowziesmobs.sand_rake: A sand rake, for drawing calm lines in stone gardens.
lore.mowziesmobs.sculptor_staff: Tongbi the Sculptor's staff. It shapes stone like clay.

lore.mowziesmobs.spear: A tribal hunter's spear, long and light. It hits wild beasts hard.
lore.mowziesmobs.umvuthana_mask_bliss: The mask of bliss. It smiles even while its wearer fights.
lore.mowziesmobs.umvuthana_mask_faith: The mask of faith, worn by those who heal the tribe.
lore.mowziesmobs.umvuthana_mask_fear: The mask of fear. Its enemies step back without knowing why.
lore.mowziesmobs.umvuthana_mask_fury: The mask of fury, red as a war ember.
lore.mowziesmobs.umvuthana_mask_misery: The mask of misery. It weeps for those it has defeated.
lore.mowziesmobs.umvuthana_mask_rage: The mask of rage, screaming without a mouth.
lore.mowziesmobs.wrought_axe: The Axe of a Thousand Metals, torn from the Wroughtnaut. Heavy, slow and devastating.
lore.mowziesmobs.wrought_helmet: The Wroughtnaut's helm, a metal monster forged by forgotten hands.
lore.mowziesmobs.clawed_log: A log scarred by claws. Something huge sharpened its nails here.
lore.mowziesmobs.gong: A bronze gong. Its rumble carries to neighboring villages.
lore.mowziesmobs.painted_acacia: Acacia wood painted in the tribe's colors.
lore.mowziesmobs.raked_sand: Sand raked into peaceful lines. The garden of a quiet mind.
lore.mowziesmobs.thatch_block: A thatch block, for hut roofs.
lore.araxers_bestiary.bestiary_book: A leather-bound bestiary. Every creature you meet leaves a page in it.
lore.dummmmmmy.target_dummy: A patient, silent training dummy. It tells you how hard you hit, and never complains.
lore.bountiful.bountyboard: The village bounty board. Every poster is a promise of reward.
